name: Annas
bio: Annas, father-in-law to the high priest Caiaphas, was himself a former high priest to whom Jesus was taken first after his arrest, before being sent on to Caiaphas (John 18:12-24). Annas presided over the council that interrogated Peter and John after the healing of the lame man, demanding to know by what power they had acted (Acts 4:5-7).
